description: Amend a track's metadata. Refused once its release has been submitted: a submitted release carries a frozen copy, and changing the catalog underneath it is the artist's own decision, because it costs credits.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

dry_run.description: True to see what would change, and what it would replace, without writing anything. Use it before overwriting words the artist wrote.

fields.description: The fields to set, by the `name` get_requirements gives each one.

name: update_track
title: Change a track
